source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U25: Identify RTI public authorities,citizens and information held or controlled

payload.title: Public authority is a legal category
payload.core_explanation_md:
RTI gives citizens the described access right to information held by or under the control of public authorities. The definition includes the specified constitutional,statutory,government-established and ownership/control/substantial-financing categories,including qualifying non-government organisations. Do not assume every private business is directly a public authority merely because it serves customers.

Information includes material held in different forms and qualifying private-body information accessible to a public authority under law. The right can involve inspection,notes,certified copies,samples and electronic access. Identify the actual record and custodian rather than demanding an officer invent a new opinion as if it were an existing record. Public-sector banking coverage does not eliminate the applicable exemption and third-party analysis.

self_check.prompt_text: Does every customer-facing private business automatically become a public authority?

payload.stem_md: A request is sent directly to a private business solely because it serves the public,without any statutory public-authority basis. What must be established?

options.explanation_md: That is not the statutory category.

options.text_md: A rule that every business is a public authority
The applicable public-authority or lawful public-authority-access route
options.explanation_md: The legal basis and record custodian matter.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The legal basis and record custodian matter.

payload.stem_md: A public authority holds the requested inspection report electronically and refuses solely because no paper original exists. Which principle is relevant?

options.text_md: Information can be held in electronic form
options.explanation_md: The right is not confined to paper records.

options.text_md: Electronic records can never be information
Every electronic record must be published without exemptions
Only handwritten records can be inspected

payload.correct_explanation_md: The right is not confined to paper records.
